status: visual reference fixed before detector execution; human review pending
method: Full original JPEG displayed through an SVG coordinate grid at one-quarter scale. Manual intervals rounded outward to approximately ten-pixel boundaries; these are body envelopes, not exact ink extents. All eight pages inspected before detector execution.
prior_context: Some pages and source descriptions were already familiar. LP2-57 record text was inspected during planning. This is not blinded, independently human annotated, or a rune-identity audit.
interval_convention: Original pixels, half-open [top,bottom). Other rectangles use [x,y,width,height]. Oversized initials and drawings do not create additional text rows.
